payload.body: Safety FYI from vc: until ISSUE:0002 lands, never run a local ccusage build against the real XDG config (eg ccusage usage, list, use or tui with your normal environment). A local build is ad hoc signed, so it is in no Claude item's access list and would raise a Keychain prompt per profile. Use a temporary HOME and XDG dirs, as tests/cli.rs's Sandbox does. After the fix the build reads through /usr/bin/security, and the live check happens with hv's OK.
